rule: Identity/specification gates are resolved before price comparison. Market anchors are references, not purchase approvals.

identity_gate: Akoya identity; reject freshwater products marketed as Akoya/Akoya-luster

reference_anchors.evidence: Akoya commonly 6-9mm; >9mm increasingly rare; GIA 7 Pearl Value Factors apply.
Current supplier listings show very wide prices and some contradictory freshwater/Akoya labeling; use only after identity confirmation.

materials.purchase_rule: Do not create a low/mid/high RMB band from marketplace search alone. Price only after identity + size + luster/surface/nacre spec is locked.

materials.pricing_unit: single loose pearl / matched pair / lot

reference_anchors.evidence: Tahitian pearls commonly 8-14mm; dark bodycolors and overtones materially affect appearance/value.
9-10mm loose examples around USD 28-42 each; wholesale-lot examples differ substantially by grade/lot.
2026-07-26 catalog asking-price benchmark reports median USD 42 for eligible loose Tahitian listings; seller catalog benchmark, not market-wide index.

materials.purchase_rule: Compare within same size + shape + overtone/luster/surface spec; do not translate seller AAA directly into project grade.

identity_gate: South Sea cultured pearl / Pinctada maxima

reference_anchors.evidence: South Sea pearls commonly 8-18mm and have thick nacre; larger size and quality factors materially affect value.

reference_anchors.source: The South Sea Pearl June 2026 snapshot
reference_anchors.evidence: White South Sea loose pearl catalog ranges: 9-10mm USD 118-549, 10-11mm USD 28-1300, 11-12mm USD 68-4741; wide spread demonstrates need for specialist model.
Supplier indicates light champagne 9-10mm AA roughly USD 120-220; 11-12mm AAA gold tone roughly USD 400-800; deep 24K 13mm+ AAA roughly USD 1200-3500. Seller guide only.

materials.purchase_rule: White/silver and golden South Sea must be separate sourcing branches. Do not build one generic South Sea price band.

identity_gate: avoid conflating plain wood, compounded incense beads and resin-rich agarwood

reference_anchors.evidence: Current Yiwu market listing for Mysore sandalwood/wood-bead products demonstrates that wood-trade names and finished-strand pricing differ strongly; not usable as agarwood identity proof.

materials.purchase_rule: No generic 8mm band. First classify exactly what the supplier is selling; then compare on gram/strand basis within the same material class.

reference_anchors.evidence: Amber value varies with color/clarity/inclusions; bright green amber is treated; important purchases may require independent lab confirmation.
Heat/oil treatment can darken/clarify amber and create spangled inclusions.
Very low-cost '二代蜜蜡' listings exist; they must not be treated as the low price tier of natural amber/beeswax amber.

materials.purchase_rule: Natural amber/beeswax only enters price comparison after identity/treatment classification; reconstructed/resin goods are separate materials, not low tier.

reference_anchors.evidence: Color, transparency and texture are the three major jadeite value factors; size and matching matter for bead strands.
A jade is natural/wax-only; B is bleached + polymer-impregnated; C is dyed; jade can be dyed, bleached, heated, waxed and impregnated.

materials.purchase_rule: Do not compare price until treatment class and material identity are known. Round beads may be compared only inside the same treatment/color/transparency class.

identity_gate: origin claim separated from material identity
certificate/traceable evidence for high-value origin claims

reference_anchors.evidence: Color, texture and clarity are important price factors; source ranges overlap in quality.
Hetian/white nephrite terminology and material identity require careful distinction from trade/origin claims.
Current Yiwu listing explicitly markets Qinghai-material 8mm Hetian-jade necklace at RMB 300-690/strand; useful commercial anchor only, not proof of Xinjiang origin.

materials.purchase_rule: Never price '和田玉' solely from the name. Record material identity and origin claim separately; use origin-neutral comparison unless evidence supports origin.

reference_anchors.evidence: Turquoise is commonly judged by color, texture and presence/absence of matrix.
Turquoise may be dyed and impregnated with polymer/wax/plastic; treatment identification is essential.

materials.purchase_rule: Natural untreated, stabilized, dyed and reconstructed/imitation turquoise must be separate sourcing classes; do not create one 8mm price band across them.

identity_gate: Dominican Republic origin consistent with Larimar definition

reference_anchors.source: 2024 Journal of South American Earth Sciences
reference_anchors.evidence: Larimar is gem-quality bluish pectolite from the Dominican Republic, often blue/green/white with associated minerals.
Fine Larimar is prized for blue color; dark blue/translucent and attractive sky-blue cloud patterns are valued.
Dyed quench-crackled chalcedony can resemble Larimar; identity must be confirmed for meaningful-value material.

materials.purchase_rule: Price by individual piece/batch after identity; round 8mm pricing can be recorded as a commercial sub-spec but must not replace focal/freeform pricing.
